d: Amerika, rus aur chin ke netaon ki prastavit pahli tripakshiy baithak ko lekar yurop men chinta barh gaee hai. shenjhen men hone vali is baithak ki tulna 1945 ke yalta sammelan se ki ja rahi hai, jahan bari shaktiyon ne yuddh ke bad duniya men apne prabhav kshetron ko lekar phaisle kie the. yukren ko dar hai ki kahin uske bhavishy ka phaisla bhi uski gairmaujudgi men na ho jae. rus is baithak ke jarie yukren yuddh par apne paksh ko majbut karna chahta hai, jabki chin aur amerika ke apne alag rannitik hit hain. aakhir is baithak ka maksad kya hai?
